moves.sectionTitle: Teleology and the inference to God
moves.currentDescription: The low-entropy beginning and thermodynamic arrow of time supply a physical account of cosmic directionality.
moves.lockedProposition: The low-entropy beginning and thermodynamic arrow of time supply a physical account of cosmic directionality.
moves.completeLockedSourceExcerpt: >> Yeah, I mean, the theory the theological aspects are It's all pretty unfamiliar to me, I mean, I must say, but um the the the directionality I think to me traces to what we know or or what our current physical theories tell us about um uh thermodynamics again and the arrow of time and and entropy. And why why is not only why is there direction, but why is there temporality at all in in in the universe as it appears to us as human beings wondering about it? I mean, it's one of the very deep questions in in cosmology and you know, one answer is that it well, it's because the universe started in a in a state of of of low entropy and is gradually expanding and and and um changing and and becoming more more high entropy. And and that just like the egg that's broken only goes in in one direction. So, you have a directionality there.

moves.currentDescription: Nature, music, poetry, and ritual disclose reality through embodied metaphors whose power is lost in explicit reduction.
moves.lockedProposition: Nature, music, poetry, and ritual disclose reality through embodied metaphors whose power is lost in explicit reduction.

They metaphorically convey to you things that can't without losing power be said explicitly.
